register.title: Evan Daniel's certificates at 172, 204, 260 and 293 at d2d5dd9, issue 845
register.headline: Daniel's new packings of 172, 204, 260 and 293 squares, 1.64e-4 to 1.18e-2 below each house
register.source_checks: The issue says the source's two exact checkers, search/exact/verify_cert.py (separating axes) and verify_cert2.py (polygon intersection), byte-identical to the copies the n183 packet retains, both report VALID on all five certificate files, and that they share an author and the certificate format. At 172 the certificate is the source's exact KKT point, with numerical evidence at 80 digits, not interval proofs, that it is a local minimum of S strict modulo 69 exact flat motions; s172_1028_regularized.cert is a regularized view at the same side. At 204, 260 and 293 the exact solver did not converge and the certificates dilate the binary64 packings by 1.5e-11 to 1.8e-11; local optimality is not established there. The commit ends with a Co-Authored-By trailer naming Claude. Those statements are the author's; no source program ran here.
register.credit: Credit Evan Daniel (https://github.com/evand/square-packing), whose population searches over his packing store found all four, after the starts the issue asks to be credited: at 172 the s(199) record of Nate Chaoweeraprasit (itsnaka), improved by Siddharth Gupta, from which an explorer search and the removal of one L-shaped strip gave 172 at side - 1; at 204 Daniil Ostashev's s(176) packing (#575), used as a seed; at 260 Kirill T's (kirilltym) s(260) from his public Kaggle notebook 'Square Packing Lab | CPU/CUDA/MPS' (side 16.638543986, 26 October), whose tilted island a fault-line composition and refill at 405 improved before a composition run put it in a 260 frame; and at 293 the 260 packing plus one L-shaped strip (Friedman's L step), with the same credit. The issue calls all four new packings, none a refinement of the register's. Kaggle per-puzzle sides it quotes at 172, 204 and 293 state no packing and are no report. The source's credits say its work was produced by Claude (Anthropic) under human direction.
register.next_rung: Independently review the retained replay and the certificates (stage 4): a clean-room exact checker, the identity against the house's packing and the lineage the source states, a mapped review whose acceptance would raise both rungs. Then adopt it at 172, 204, 260 and 293 under the house rule, with both strong generators' regularization and the flip of each new house in the same change.
